detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This is an idle game with rich skill development and upgrade elements.

Gameplay

At the center of the island stands a mysterious cube that constantly spits out resources. Before long, an entire stone tribe begins revolving around it in a frenzy.

Some villagers punch the cube. Others run around collecting the coins and resources scattered everywhere. And your job is to keep the whole tribe growing.

This is more than just a typical idle game. As the cube levels up, the resource cycle gradually becomes unstable. You’ll need to continuously adjust skills, professions, and growth paths to keep the entire system running efficiently.
From simple gathering to complex synergies. From a handful of tiny villagers to a massive tribe operating at full speed and impossible to stop.

The Stone Tribe

As the game progresses, you’ll gradually unlock:

  • More professions and skill builds

  • Talent combinations and temple blessings

  • Seasonal island challenges and growth rewards

  • Increasingly absurd numbers and screen-filling effects

You can play casually and let the tribe idle on its own. Or dive deep into optimizing every possible growth route and efficiency chain. Until the entire island is consumed by a flood of resources.

Features

  • Incremental gameplay built around resource flow and growth balance

  • Expanding systems of skills, professions, and builds

  • Evolves from light idle gameplay into complex resource synergies

  • Satisfying late-game explosions of resources, effects, and scaling numbers

  • Charming pixel art and a constantly thriving stone tribe
